_doc: The owner flag planted on owned towns, mines and dwellings of the adventure map (bead bzc.146, docs/art/classes/map-objects.md#owner-flags). One sprite, generated at native display size with the cloth in neutral white and light grey so the renderer recolours it per player (src/render/map/owner-flag.ts keeps the outline, the pole and the shading and maps the cloth's grey steps onto the player colour's ramp); its gentle wave is a code-made column shift of the cloth, not separate takes. generate-image-v2 like the other map objects (32 x 32 gives 64 candidates, 48 x 48 gives 25); the imported sawmill is the style image for outline, pixel size and viewing angle only. Layers: style, light-south-west, subject (the class-map-object layer describes buildings and forbids banners). Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleSawmill.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

recipes.concept: OWNER FLAG (small, on towers and roofs)
recipes.subject: Subject: one chunky little flag on a short pole, for a board-game map, seen from the front: a straight thin dark brown wooden pole #5a3a1e standing upright at the left side of the image from the top to the bottom, a small round gold knob #f2c230 on its top, and a wide plain cloth flying out to the right from the top of the pole in a gentle wave, one big simple shape with a thick black outline. The cloth is plain pure white #f4f4f4 with one light grey #b4b4b4 shadow tone in its folds, and no pattern, emblem, stripe or colour at all. Each image a different one of these cloth shapes: a rectangular flag; a swallowtail flag with a notch in its fly end; a long pointed pennant; a square banner. The cloth fills about two thirds of the image width and a third of its height; the pole is the full image height.
